# 2 bed apartment for sale

> Grimes are delighted to welcome No. 195 Churchfields to the market. This spacious two bedroom, two bathroom apartment extends to approximately 80 sq. m. / 861 sq. ft. and offers well proportioned accommodation throughout. On entering the property, you are greeted by a welcoming entrance hall.
